focus: Classify six tier-0 templates as needs-pointer or correctly-inert

graphEvents.label: Are the six unread tier-0 forms needs-pointer or correctly-inert?
Five of six tier-0 forms correctly-inert; daily-range needs-pointer
Bar/track forms print a value label beside every mark; unit forms print counts in the key

label: unit-ring, unit-grid, independent-percentages, bar-columns, bar-rows are correctly-inert: every encoded value is printed inside the figure (key counts, key shares, per-track/per-bar/per-column value labels)
daily-range is needs-pointer: each day's minimum and maximum exist only as bar-endpoint geometry (daily-range.html:263-264); the figure prints only day numbers and axis rungs
Corpus-wide printed-value convention: four of the six forms draw a value text node beside every mark, so the mark label already restates what a tooltip would say

direction: Classifying daily-range as correctly-inert because its data-chart-table carries both bounds
reason: The table is universal across all 21 templates (iteration 1) and therefore cannot discriminate; the rubric requires the value printed inside the figure, next to or on its mark, and daily-range prints neither endpoint
